recipient_is_blacklisted.meaning: the recipient address of the cross-chain mint is blacklisted
recipient_is_blacklisted.checkpoint: before the cross-chain mint message is processed

cross_chain_mint_message_arrived.meaning: a cross-chain message has arrived via LayerZero to mint tokens to a user on the Spoke chain
cross_chain_mint_message_arrived.checkpoint: before the mint is executed on the Spoke chain

channel_permanently_blocked_observed.meaning: the cross-chain channel is effectively permanently blocked because the failed message's nonce remains strictly ordered and the blacklisted message never succeeds
channel_permanently_blocked_observed.checkpoint: after the blacklisted-recipient mint message fails

claims.scope: LayerZero cross-chain message delivery minting iTryTokenOFT tokens on the Spoke chain (MegaETH)

preconditions.text: The recipient address of the cross-chain mint is blacklisted.; A cross-chain message arrives via LayerZero to mint tokens to a user on the Spoke chain.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A blacklisted recipient of a bridge mint should not cause the LayerZero message execution to revert in a way that blocks processing of subsequent higher-nonce messages for other users.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Because the failed message's nonce remains strictly ordered and the blacklisted message never succeeds, the cross-chain channel is effectively permanently blocked.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The blacklisted-recipient mint message is the message whose failure is claimed to block the ordered channel.
The channel's nonce ordering is strictly sequential so a failed message blocks later higher-nonce messages, as stated in the impact text.

limitations: Formalizes only the channel_permanently_blocked impact; the lzReceive revert and broader bridge DoS are separate impacts not covered here.
Permanence is treated as the report's stated effective permanence given strict nonce ordering, not as an unbounded temporal claim.
